records.text: Right after—I haven't done that, and I kind of want to. Which, like—she did. She went to multiple mediums. Like, one in New York where you don't tell them or even his assistant who you are or anything about you, and you go to this hotel room. And you would just like sit there. I was like, "Talking about it is so weird," and both her first husband and David popped up. "Are you serious?"
records.speaker: Brett Cooper
